page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1ne-c8d3.8xlarge is a storage-focused instance powered by the Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. It features 32 dedicated physical cores and 32 vCPUs, paired with 128.0 GB of RAM, yielding a resource density of 4.0 GB per core. The instance is equipped with a massive 70866 GB of local HDD storage and provides a baseline network bandwidth of 20 Gbps under the KVM hypervisor.

Performance benchmarks indicate a clear distinction between single-core and multi-core capabilities. Single-core metrics, such as stress-ng and Geekbench single-core scores, fall into the bottom 25%, reflecting the older architecture of the Xeon E5-2682v4. However, multi-core performance, including Passmark CPU and Geekbench multi-core tests, reaches average levels. Memory bandwidth tests demonstrate average read and write speeds, though the overall Passmark memory score remains in the lower quartile.

The primary tradeoff of this instance is its reliance on high-capacity HDD storage rather than solid-state drives, which limits random I/O performance but offers exceptional storage density. This configuration is highly cost-efficient for workloads requiring massive local storage capacity without the premium cost of SSDs. It is best suited for large-scale data warehousing, distributed file systems, log processing, and database backups where sequential read/write operations dominate.
